# components/sheet

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.ts from components/sheet/sheet.ts — edit the source, then `deno task docs`. -->

Import: `import { Sheet } from "@tundralibs/ui/sheet"`

Rendered in every variant on the catalogue (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/index.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Sheet`

```ts
Sheet(props: SheetProps): Html
```

A side panel for a secondary task — a detail view, an edit form, a
filter rail — that keeps the page behind it in sight. A native
`<dialog>` opened with `.showModal()` (focus trap and `::backdrop` for
free) by any element carrying `data-sheet-open="#<id>"`; closed by
`[data-sheet-close]`, a click on the backdrop, or Escape. Slides in from
`side` on a wide screen; below 768px it is always a bottom sheet with a
drag handle, capped at 85vh, scrolling inside. The header and footer
stay put while the body scrolls.

## Types

### `SheetSide`

Which edge the panel comes from on a wide screen; below 768px every sheet is a bottom sheet.

- `"end"`
- `"start"`
- `"bottom"`

### `SheetSize`

Panel width (height for a bottom sheet): sm 20rem, md 28rem, lg 40rem.

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `SheetProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Required: a trigger opens it by id (`data-sheet-open="#<id>"`). |
| `title` | `string | Html` |  | Heading in the sticky header; omit for a bare panel and give `label`. |
| `body` | `string | Html` | yes | The scrolling content. |
| `footer` | `string | Html` |  | Sticky row at the foot — the actions of a form in the sheet. |
| `side` | `SheetSide` |  | Edge it slides in from. @default "end" |
| `size` | `SheetSize` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name when there is no visible title. |
| `open` | `boolean` |  | Open as soon as it is on the page — on load, and when a swap puts it there (sheet.js). Re-render a form's sheet with `open` after a failed submit so its errors are in front of the person. |
| `closable` | `boolean` |  | Draw no close button in the header (a flow that must finish). |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### Edit a record beside the list

Any element with `data-sheet-open="#<id>"` opens it; `data-sheet-close` closes. Below 768px it is a bottom sheet.

```ts
html`
  ${Button({ label: "Edit", variant: "outline", attrs: { "data-sheet-open": "#edit-member" } })}${Sheet({
    id: "edit-member",
    title: "Edit member",
    body: html`
      <form id="edit-member-form" method="post" action="/members/42" data-action="/members/42" data-target="#members">
        ${FormField({
          id: "name",
          label: "Name",
          control: Input({ id: "name", name: "name", value: "Ada Lovelace" }),
        })}
      </form>
    `,
    footer: html`
      ${Button({ label: "Cancel", variant: "ghost", attrs: { "data-sheet-close": "" } })}${Button({
        label: "Save",
        type: "submit",
        attrs: { form: "edit-member-form" },
      })}
    `,
  })}
`
```

```html
<button type="button" class="btn btn--outline" data-sheet-open="#edit-member">Edit</button>
<dialog class="sheet sheet--end sheet--md" id="edit-member" aria-labelledby="edit-member-title" data-sheet="">
  <div class="sheet__panel">
    <span class="sheet__handle" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <div class="sheet__header">
      <h2 class="sheet__title" id="edit-member-title">Edit member</h2>
      <button type="button" class="sheet__close" data-sheet-close aria-label="Close">
        <svg width="16" height="16" width="2" …>…</svg>
      </button>
    </div>
    <div class="sheet__body">
      <form id="edit-member-form" method="post" action="/members/42" data-action="/members/42" data-target="#members">
        <div class="form-field">
          <label class="form-field__label" for="name">Name</label>
          <input type="text" class="input" id="name" name="name" value="Ada Lovelace">
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
    <div class="sheet__footer">
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost" data-sheet-close="">Cancel</button>
      <button type="submit" class="btn" form="edit-member-form">Save</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

### A form that failed comes back open

Re-render the sheet with `open: true` from the handler and the errors are in front of the person.

```ts
Sheet({
  id: "invite",
  title: "Invite a teammate",
  open: true,
  size: "sm",
  body: FormField({
    id: "email",
    label: "Email",
    error: "That address is already a member.",
    control: Input({ id: "email", name: "email", type: "email", value: "grace@acme.com", invalid: true }),
  }),
  footer: Button({ label: "Send invite", type: "submit" }),
})
```

```html
<dialog class="sheet sheet--end sheet--sm" id="invite" aria-labelledby="invite-title" data-sheet="" data-sheet-autoopen="">
  <div class="sheet__panel">
    <span class="sheet__handle" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <div class="sheet__header">
      <h2 class="sheet__title" id="invite-title">Invite a teammate</h2>
      <button type="button" class="sheet__close" data-sheet-close aria-label="Close">
        <svg width="16" height="16" width="2" …>…</svg>
      </button>
    </div>
    <div class="sheet__body">
      <div class="form-field">
        <label class="form-field__label" for="email">Email</label>
        <input type="email" class="input input--invalid" id="email" name="email" value="grace@acme.com" aria-invalid="true">
        <p class="form-field__error" id="email-error" role="alert">That address is already a member.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sheet__footer">
      <button type="submit" class="btn">Send invite</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

## Behaviour

`components/sheet/sheet.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-sheet`, `data-sheet-autoopen`, `data-sheet-autoopened`, `data-sheet-close`, `data-sheet-open`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`.
